title: DESK ARCHITECTURE — agentic IDE on nestgate.io
thesis: nestgate.io/desk is the agentic desk. Like Cursor but open, free, in the browser. Sub-panes for chat/RSS/probes/fossils/discuss. HUD hologram inverts — desk icons ON the hud planet, hud looking DOWN at the desk. Chipmunk plays on the other side. All questions become probes, all answers become validations to consume and cross-check.

panes.chat: terminal — 20 MCP tools via natural language, the command line of the membrane
panes.rss: what's new — RSS teach-back from sporePrint/hud/connect, new papers surface here
panes.probes: every question becomes a probe with status (pending?answered?validated?resolved)
panes.fossils: dead weather — stale feeds, ghosts, stack errors, things to clean and fossilize
panes.discuss: sovereign threads — page-anchored, no login, persists in membrane
panes.hud: HUD hologram — looking DOWN from desk into the membrane (iframe embed)
panes.desk: HUD desk (full) — the existing 14-tab workspace via iframe
panes.chipmunk: the other side — chipmunk plays here, separate easel
panes.membrane: membrane observe — who's visiting, what's the fleet doing

inversions.desk_on_hud: desk icons appear as hologram nodes on hud.primals.eco — the planet surface shows the workspace
inversions.hud_on_desk: iframe pane in desk shows the HUD looking down — the desk contains the hologram
inversions.chipmunk_other_side: chipmunk pane is the flip side — same Klein bottle, different face

probe_lifecycle.1_ask: human types question in chat pane
probe_lifecycle.2_route: keyword matcher sends to correct MCP tool
probe_lifecycle.3_answer: squirrel returns data, probe status ? answered
probe_lifecycle.4_validate: human marks as validated or flags discrepancy
probe_lifecycle.5_crosscheck: probe feeds back into membrane ? consumed and resolved
probe_lifecycle.6_fossil: resolved probes become fossils — cleaned dead weather

stack_heroes_to_find: 0 probes for non-p (pi errors, irrational remainder edge cases)
null/NaN in MCP responses ? surface in fossils pane
stale feeds (34 of 35) ? dead weather to clean
chair ACK 404 ? northGate neutrino still missing
